notes.title: Editor Hotfix
notes.notes:
There was a bug where improperly saved editor data could corrupt one of the menus, interrupting the loading process and causing each level to immediately shutdown. That has been fixed!

I've also made sure that, at least until I add specific research tools into the editor, that states will load with the minimum research necessary to support the bases that you've given them. 
(If a state spawns with a silo, it will be given level 1 ICBM research.)

Thanks [i]Mr. Grimm[/i] and [i]goosboi [/i]for the bug reports!

notes.title: Multiplayer Patch #5!
notes.notes:
[h3]Update to v2.4.48[/h3]
More netcode bug-squashing!

[list]
[*] Fixed a number of RPC feedback-loops that often led to potentially massive chunks of bandwidth being dedicated to completely useless messages! 
[*] Drastically reduced the precision and frequency of network-transform updates, which was also hogging large amounts of bandwidth for no gain. (Sub-millimeter unit position updates aren't that valuable in a world-scale game)

These two fixes, in test scenarios, resulted a [i]huge[/i] reduction of bandwidth use. Hopefully this is the big fix for hosting larger servers!

[*] Fixed a bug with sometimes being unable to disband your own troops
[*] General streamlining of several common network messages
[*] Improvements to disconnect/state death logic 
[/list]

Thanks for hanging in there with me with the netcode issues! Post bugs in the community discord!
[i]-spacemann[/i]

notes.title: Multiplayer Patch #4
notes.notes:
[h3]Update to 2.4.44[/h3]
One day, many years into the future, there wont be any more netcode bugs. This is not that day. 

[list]
[*] Corrected Interpolation Settings (this should [i]really[/i] help with hosting large servers!)
[*] Patched a game-breaking country defeat/disconnect bug that would freeze the map and cause all sorts of problems
[*] Automatically clean unit information continuously (may cause minor performance impact, but is a safeguard against map-freezes!)
[*] Fixed an issue where a disconnect would end the game for everyone
[*] Fixed an issue where airbases wouldn't properly apply research in multiplayer
[/list]

Hopefully not too many more of these will be needed! Please let me know if you run into any bugs! Best place to message is the community discord. 
- [i]spacemann[/i]

notes.title: Multiplayer Patch #3
notes.notes:
[h3]Spectating Improvements[/h3]
- Added 'Spectators', a unique player-type
Set your name to "spectator" before the match starts, and you will be able to watch the game without playing. 
[I](Likely to have some bugs, let me know in the discord if you find stuff!)[/i]

-Improved normal spectating!
If you lose a multiplayer match, you can now continue watching as a spectator, and leave without ending the game [i](unless you are the host)[/i]

[h3]QOL Improvements![/h3]
- Unique panels for each gamestate are now visible in the pause menu
- Auto-lose scenarios are now reloaded (thanks FireWarp!)

[h3]Multiplayer Bugfixes[/h3]
- Research VFX and Sounds now work in multiplayer again!
- Server or Client Disconnects are now handled, instead of previously causing undefined behavior
- Addressed issue of not being able to spawn troops during war with non-adjacent nation
- Hopefully resolved issue where units wouldn't path correctly to faraway destinations [i](caused by an errant 'optimization')[/i]
- Resolved inaccurate score reporting
- Removed some unnecessary recursion that could have caused host slowdown
- Fixed a network race-condition in the multiplayer settings that sometimes caused whitescreen error (improper map load)

[i][b]Please let me know of any bugs you find in the #bug-reporting channel in the discord! [/b]

Have fun!
-spacemann[/i]

notes.title: Multiplayer Patch #2
notes.notes:
2.4.2
The war on bugs continues! 
[list]
[*] New Desync checker on armies will hopefully catch up and fix army desync when it occurs. (not 100% effective, but it helps!)
[*] Dropped multiplayer tickrate to give host machines a chance at handling large-server bandwidth
[*] Added new (probably insequential) 'path sharing' optimization on neighboring units to attempt to reduce CPU load
[*] Improved multiplayer spectating! (still not amazing)
[*] Attempted to solve issues encountered when hosting sequential games (thanks sev!)
[*] Added new end-screens for multiplayer matches, including spectating and victory screens (WIP)
[*] Added a whole bunch of new and exciting bugs! 
[/list]

Thanks for bearing with me folks, this isn't over yet!

notes.title: 2.3.4 - Minor Changes
notes.notes:
[h3][h1]2.3.4 Patch Notes[/h1][/h3]
	⁃	Added CRT = 0 setting for eye problems
This setting disables all the scanline effects, the visual fuzz, and the lens distortion for all screens. Enable this setting by typing "CRT = 0" into any console. 

	⁃	Removed and replaced an unreasonably difficult achievement
"Teraton" required the player to drop a completely unreasonable amount of nukes. Gigaton is difficult enough, I think.
Teraton was replaced with a pretty obvious easter egg, because I thought it was cute. 

	⁃	Added non-scoring diplomatic endings (thanks Derek)
There were cases where the game had reached a natural conclusion, but victory wasn't being offered, which should now be addressed. 

	⁃	Removed the necessity of typing multiplayer while not actually forcing online connectivity
	⁃	Fixed trying to store stats without steam connection
	⁃	Removed FPS counter and seed display to declutter console
	⁃	Disallowed canceling tutorial research
